## Manuscripts in Preparation

* **Studying the decline in seroprevalence after the introduction of Foot-and-mouth disease vaccination in India.** In collaboration with Dr. Glen Guyver-Fletcher, Dr. Matthew Ferrari, and Dr. Mike Tildesley.

* **Tracking progress to measles elimination using routinely collected subnational surveillance data: a case study from Nigeria.** Led by Dr. Indrajit Ghosh, in collaboration with Dr. Matt Ferrari and Dr. Amy Winter.

* **Modelling Foot-and-Mouth Disease in India.** Led by Dr. Guyver-Fletcher, in collaboration with Dr. Matt Ferrari and Dr. Mike Tildesley.

* **Predicting the performance of supplementary immunization activities.** Manuscript in preparation.
